title: Real Estate Agent Hypnosis
description:
You're viewing a home, and the estate agent is quite attractive, and a little forward as her heels click around the spacious, well-presented and generously proportioned three-bed suburban. In fact, the more she shows you around, the more you seem to want to follow her, until you make it to the south-facing, beautifully-appointed master bedroom, and find out who the master is...

A real estate roleplay that blends property listing, hypnosis and femdom to erotic effect as you fall under my spell just from hearing about the house, and how I'll use you in it after you buy it!
